I added an "Agenda" item to the portal menu, as the third entry after Accueil and Catalogue de données. The form is valid.

It is a standard page of type "Catalogue d'événements" (`event-catalog`), which is the page that lists all published events. I did not use "Page d'événements", since that variant points to one specific event page.

I left the icon, the colour and the "open in a new tab" option at their defaults.
